name: healthy
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "fixed_load.va"
simulator lang=spice
.include "models.spice"
.include "ldo_ota5.spi"
.temp 27
EADAPTER vin 0 line_cmd 0 1
VREF vref 0 0.8
IBIAS vin ibias 50u
RLOAD vout 0 120
XLDO vin vout 0 vref ibias fb gate_drive gate ldo_ota5
RFBTOP vout fb 300k
RFBBOT fb 0 600k
VLOOP gate_drive gate 0
RESR vout vcap 50m
COUT vcap 0 1e-06
simulator lang=spectre
XLOAD (vout load_cmd load_current) fixed_load
VOBSOUT (vout vout_read) vsource dc=0
XM (vout_read line_cmd load_cmd stage done startup_peak_mv startup_offset_mv startup_recovery_us startup_status line_up_peak_mv line_up_offset_mv line_up_recovery_us line_up_status line_down_peak_mv line_down_offset_mv line_down_recovery_us line_down_status load_up_peak_mv load_up_offset_mv load_up_recovery_us load_up_status load_down_peak_mv load_down_offset_mv load_down_recovery_us load_down_status) ldo_experiment ramp_end=2.1e-05
tran tran stop=240u maxstep=5n errpreset=conservative
save VOBSOUT:p vout vin load_current line_cmd load_cmd stage done startup_peak_mv startup_offset_mv startup_recovery_us startup_status line_up_peak_mv line_up_offset_mv line_up_recovery_us line_up_status line_down_peak_mv line_down_offset_mv line_down_recovery_us line_down_status load_up_peak_mv load_up_offset_mv load_up_recovery_us load_up_status load_down_peak_mv load_down_offset_mv load_down_recovery_us load_down_status
